newsitem.title: USA: Peregrine acquires automotive metal stamping firm.
newsitem.headline: Peregrine acquires automotive metal stamping firm.

text.p: Recently formed auto parts supplier Peregrine Inc. said Monday it has acquired MSI Manufacturing Group Inc., a supplier of automotive sheet metal stampings, assemblies, prototypes and tooling.
The purchase price was not disclosed.
MSI, based in Madison Heights, Mich., has annual sales of about $119 million and 760 employees in four major facilities -- three in Warren, Mich., and one in Battle Creek, Mich.

Both Peregrine and MSI are privately held. Peregrine was formed six months ago when a management group backed by the New York investment firm of Joseph, Littlejohn & Levy acquired four of General Motors Corp.'s Delphi Automotive Systems parts plants in Michigan and Ontario.

Peregrine said MSI will become part of the Metalforming business unit of its Exterior Systems Group. It said the acquisition will make it one of the largest domestic manufacturers of metal canisters for passenger-side air bags and will allow the company to supply automakers with complex metal stampings and assemblies that have tight tolerances.
